Ramayana Film Project Budget Clarified by Actor Yash

Actor Yash addressed claims regarding the budget of a planned Ramayana film project, stating it is not ₹4,000 crore. He clarified that the project's scale is global and that details will be revealed later. The film is intended to be a grand cinematic experience.
